test_cases.title: Header product mark scrolls the page back to the top when clicked
preconditions: Visitor has scrolled down (e.g. to the Hierarchy section)

steps.expected: The square icon contains the letter "F" beside the "FleetIQ" wordmark

Not a new requirement — coverage of text that was always there. Extended 2026-09-21 to assert the square icon contains "F": TR-003 states the mark is a square icon *containing "F"* beside the wordmark, and no case asserted the glyph. Coverage of existing text, not a new requirement.
